props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Sphere of Annihilation - Sequencer + ONI Pseudo (Step In/Out)

//

// Requirements:

// - Sequencer active

// - game.ONI.pseudo.play available

//

// Sound sync (Sequencer-only):

// - Sphere VFX spawn = Darkness3.ogg

// - Sphere VFX despawn = Damage5.ogg

//

// Notes:

// - Damage sound is timed to the END of the Sphere effect (when it despawns)

// - oni:animationEnd is emitted AFTER the caster finishes returning (pipeline-safe)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][SphereOfAnnihilation]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

console.error(TAG, "Missing game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

// --- Ensure ONI.emit exists (pipeline-friendly) ---

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & targets ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("SphereOfAnnihilation: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("SphereOfAnnihilation: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- Disposition rule (your standard) ---

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

// If enemy (-1) => move RIGHT, else LEFT

const moveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

const squares = 0.35;

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const dx = moveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// --- Timings ---

const moveMs = 350;

const bufferToVfxMs = 50;

const vfxScaleInMs = 400;

const vfxHoldMs = 3000;

const vfxFadeOutMs = 500;

const vfxTotalMs = vfxScaleInMs + vfxHoldMs + vfxFadeOutMs; // 3900ms

// Pseudo hold window (starts AFTER step-out completes)

const holdMs = bufferToVfxMs + vfxTotalMs;

// --- Assets ---

const VFX_FILE =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Item/SphereOfAnnihilation_01_Regular_Purple_200x200.webm";

const SFX_SPHERE =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness3.ogg";

const SFX_DESPAWN =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage5.ogg";

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "sphereOfAnnihilation",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// PSEUDO: step out -> hold -> step back (continuous; no snap flash)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animateXY(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs, easeFn) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = (easeFn ?? easeInOutCubic)(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const moveMs = Number(params.moveMs ?? 350);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token locally once

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const homeX = sprite.x, homeY = sprite.y;

const outX = homeX + dx, outY = homeY;

await animateXY(sprite, homeX, homeY, outX, outY, moveMs, easeInOutCubic);

if (holdMs > 0) await wait(holdMs);

await animateXY(sprite, outX, outY, homeX, homeY, moveMs, easeInOutCubic);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.sphereOfAnnihilation.stepHoldBack",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: { dx, moveMs, holdMs },

meta: { source: "SphereOfAnnihilation" },

});

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// SEQUENCER: VFX + SFX timeline (Sequencer plays BOTH sounds)

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const seq = new Sequence();

// Wait until caster finishes step-out, then spawn sphere

seq.wait(moveMs + bufferToVfxMs);

// Sphere spawn sound (sync with sphere appearing)

seq.sound().file(SFX_SPHERE).volume(0.95);

// Sphere effect (scale in, hold, fade out)

seq.effect()

.file(VFX_FILE)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(1.5)

.scaleIn(0, vfxScaleInMs, { ease: "easeOutCubic" })

.duration(vfxTotalMs)

.fadeOut(vfxFadeOutMs, { ease: "easeOutQuint", delay: -vfxFadeOutMs });

// Sphere despawn sound (sync with effect END)

// We schedule it relative to the moment the effect starts (right now in the timeline)

seq.sound().file(SFX_DESPAWN).delay(vfxTotalMs).volume(0.95);

// Wait until caster has time to finish returning before we end the cinematic

// (Return starts when hold ends, which matches vfxTotalMs window)

seq.wait(vfxTotalMs + moveMs + 50);

await seq.play();

// --- Broadcast end (after return is done) ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "sphereOfAnnihilation",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END", { moveMs, holdMs, vfxTotalMs });

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "sphereOfAnnihilation", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

props.animation_script:
/**

* Oni - Pseudo Animation Macro (Foundry VTT v12)

* - Screen dimmer (PIXI)

* - VFX on caster (PIXI video sprite)

* - SFX via Sequencer

* - Wait 2000ms then undim

* - Emits animation start/end signals

*/

(async () => {

const CONFIG = {

// Screen dimmer

DIM_ALPHA: 0.65,

DIM_FADE_IN_MS: 200,

DIM_FADE_OUT_MS: 200,

// Timing

HOLD_MS: 2000,

// VFX (PIXI)

VFX_FILE: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/1st_Level/Thunderwave/Thunderwave_01_Bright_Blue_Center_600x600.webm",

VFX_SCALE_MULT: 5, // ✅ updated to 3

VFX_FADE_OUT_MS: 250,

// SFX (Sequencer)

SFX_FILE: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Monster2.ogg",

SFX_VOLUME: 0.9

};

const RUN_ID = `${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000)}`;

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function getCasterToken() {

return canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? globalThis.token ?? null;

}

function tween(displayObject, vars) {

if (!globalThis.gsap) {

ui.notifications.warn("GSAP not found. Tweening may not work on this client.");

Object.assign(displayObject, vars);

return Promise.resolve();

}

return new Promise((resolve) => {

gsap.to(displayObject, { ...vars, onComplete: resolve });

});

}

function emitAnimSignal(eventName, payload) {

// Local hook signal

try { Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload); } catch (e) { /* no-op */ }

// Optional: module socket signal

try {

game.socket?.emit?.("module.fabula-ultima-companion", {

type: eventName,

payload

});

} catch (e) { /* no-op */ }

}

function createScreenDimmer() {

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(0x000000, 1);

g.drawRect(0, 0, canvas.dimensions.width, canvas.dimensions.height);

g.endFill();

g.alpha = 0;

g.zIndex = 900000;

g.name = "oni-screen-dimmer";

canvas.stage.addChild(g);

return g;

}

async function loadVfxTexture(src) {

if (globalThis.VideoHelper?.createTexture) return await VideoHelper.createTexture(src);

if (globalThis.VideoHelper?.getOrCreateTexture) return await VideoHelper.getOrCreateTexture(src);

if (globalThis.loadTexture) return await loadTexture(src);

return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

function tryStartVideo(texture) {

const res = texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source ?? res?.data ?? null;

if (!vid) return;

try {

vid.loop = false;

vid.muted = true; // SFX is separate

vid.play?.();

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][PseudoAnim] Video autoplay failed:", e);

}

}

async function playVfxOnCaster(caster) {

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

const tex = await loadVfxTexture(CONFIG.VFX_FILE);

tryStartVideo(tex);

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.position.set(caster.center.x, caster.center.y);

// Scale so 600x600 roughly fits the token size, then apply multiplier

const baseScale = (Math.max(caster.w, caster.h) / 600) * CONFIG.VFX_SCALE_MULT;

spr.scale.set(baseScale);

spr.alpha = 1;

spr.zIndex = 900001;

spr.name = "oni-caster-vfx";

canvas.stage.addChild(spr);

return spr;

}

async function playSfxSequencer() {

if (!globalThis.Sequence) {

ui.notifications.warn("Sequencer not found. SFX will be skipped.");

return;

}

try {

await new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(CONFIG.SFX_FILE)

.volume(CONFIG.SFX_VOLUME)

.play();

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][PseudoAnim] SFX play failed:", e);

}

}

let dimmer = null;

let vfxSprite = null;

let started = false;

let status = "ok";

const basePayload = {

runId: RUN_ID,

// filled after caster exists:

casterName: null,

casterUuid: null

};

try {

const caster = getCasterToken();

if (!caster) {

ui.notifications.error("Select your caster token first.");

return;

}

basePayload.casterName = caster.name ?? caster.actor?.name ?? "Unknown";

basePayload.casterUuid = caster.document?.uuid ?? caster.actor?.uuid ?? null;

// ✅ animation start signal

emitAnimSignal("oni:animationStart", {

...basePayload,

ts: Date.now()

});

started = true;

// 1) Dim the screen

dimmer = createScreenDimmer();

await tween(dimmer, { alpha: CONFIG.DIM_ALPHA, duration: CONFIG.DIM_FADE_IN_MS / 1000 });

// 2) VFX + SFX at the same time

[vfxSprite] = await Promise.all([

playVfxOnCaster(caster),

playSfxSequencer()

]);

// 3) Wait 2000ms

await sleep(CONFIG.HOLD_MS);

// 4) Undim + fade VFX out

await Promise.all([

vfxSprite

? tween(vfxSprite, { alpha: 0, duration: CONFIG.VFX_FADE_OUT_MS / 1000 })

: Promise.resolve(),

tween(dimmer, { alpha: 0, duration: CONFIG.DIM_FADE_OUT_MS / 1000 })

]);

} catch (err) {

status = "error";

console.error("[ONI][PseudoAnim] Macro error:", err);

ui.notifications.error("Animation macro failed. Check console (F12) for details.");

} finally {

// Cleanup (stop video + destroy PIXI objects)

try {

if (vfxSprite) {

const tex = vfxSprite.texture;

const res = tex?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source ?? res?.data ?? null;

vid?.pause?.();

vfxSprite.destroy({ children: true });

}

if (dimmer) dimmer.destroy(true);

} catch (e) {

console.warn("[ONI][PseudoAnim] Cleanup warning:", e);

}

// ✅ animation end signal (fires even if error happened after start)

if (started) {

emitAnimSignal("oni:animationEnd", {

...basePayload,

ts: Date.now(),

status

});

}

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][DraconicRoar]";

const DEBUG = true;

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

const args = p.__confirmArgs || {}; // applyDamage-button injects this :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

// ---------- helpers ----------

const num = (v) => {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;

};

const getLevel = (actor) =>

Number(actor?.system?.props?.level ?? actor?.system?.level ?? 0) || 0;

// Prefer your pipeline snapshot first (fast + consistent)

const getMDefFromSnapshot = (targetUuid) => {

const list = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget;

if (!Array.isArray(list)) return null;

const row = list.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return num(row?.mdef);

};

// Fallback: read from actor data directly

const readMagicDefense = (actor) => {

const props = actor?.system?.props ?? actor?.system ?? {};

return (

num(props.magic_defense) ??

num(props.current_mdef) ??

num(props.mdef) ??

0

);

};

const pickRandom = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

// ---------- resolve caster ----------

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

args?.attackerUuid ??

null;

const attackerDoc = attackerUuid ? await fromUuid(attackerUuid).catch(() => null) : null;

const casterActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!casterActor) return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster actor.");

const casterLevel = getLevel(casterActor);

// ---------- accuracy total (best sources) ----------

// 1) payload.accuracy.total (from ActionDataComputation)

// 2) confirm args accuracyTotal (from CreateActionCard button)

const accTotal =

num(p?.accuracy?.total) ??

num(args?.accuracyTotal) ??

null;

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

// auto-hit rules (match your confirm behavior style)

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const targets = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targets.length) return console.warn(TAG, "No targets in payload.");

// ---------- debuff pools ----------

const BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL = [

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.nGDTBPQ9omhKG3rM",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.GbLFOJUgTjJnaM4V",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.u6SHYfoeExl1etSf",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.dnzpUdhxjd6H3ktJ",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.h3M2iAUzB26A4zNo",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.62gUkhQExwD9DvaI"

];

const STRONG_DEBUFF_POOL = [

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.3LvW5XEm1E1dYrZa",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.owA4mhwuMM1Gh18f",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.y5YpJbxvkHnHA1Fc",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.OYLYpaZMWDFRMPgk",

"Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.6TmDCjk1jdit5YtZ"

];

if (DEBUG) {

console.log(TAG, "START", {

caster: casterActor.name,

casterLevel,

hasAccuracy,

accTotal,

autoHit,

targetsCount: targets.length,

hasDefenseSnapshot: !!p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot

});

}

// ---------- per target ----------

for (const tuuid of targets) {

const tDoc = await fromUuid(tuuid).catch(() => null);

const targetActor = tDoc?.actor ?? tDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const targetLevel = getLevel(targetActor);

// Your rule: compare accuracy total vs Magic Defense

const mdef =

getMDefFromSnapshot(tuuid) ??

readMagicDefense(targetActor);

let isHit = true;

if (!hasAccuracy) {

isHit = true; // no check => always apply

} else if (autoHit) {

isHit = true;

} else if (accTotal === null) {

// This was your exact failure case before.

isHit = false;

console.warn(TAG, "Missing accTotal even though hasAccuracy=true -> treating as MISS", {

target: targetActor.name,

mdef,

pHasAccuracyObj: !!p?.accuracy,

argsAccuracyTotal: args?.accuracyTotal

});

} else {

isHit = (accTotal >= mdef);

}

if (!isHit) {

if (DEBUG) console.log(TAG, "MISS -> no debuff", { target: targetActor.name, accTotal, mdef });

continue;

}

const strongUpgrade = (casterLevel - targetLevel) >= 5;

const pool = strongUpgrade ? STRONG_DEBUFF_POOL : BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL;

const chosenUuid = pickRandom(pool);

const sourceEffect = await fromUuid(chosenUuid).catch(() => null);

if (!sourceEffect) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve source ActiveEffect:", chosenUuid);

continue;

}

const effectData = foundry.utils.deepClone(sourceEffect.toObject());

delete effectData._id;

delete effectData.id;

// optional: prevent duplicate by name

const existing = targetActor.effects?.find(e => e?.name === effectData.name);

if (existing) await existing.delete();

await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

if (DEBUG) console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor.name,

targetLevel,

casterLevel,

strongUpgrade,

chosenUuid,

effectName: effectData.name

});

}

if (DEBUG) console.log(TAG, "DONE");

})();

// ONI — Clockwork Blades (polished: X-only sidestep, no Y drift)

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][FX]";

// --- Assets ---

const SFX_MOVE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const FX_TARGET = "modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/07-steampunk/clock/Clockwork_Blades_1_1200x1200.webm";

const SFX_TARGET = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Haste.ogg";

// --- Checks ---

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error(`${TAG} Sequencer module is not active.`);

return;

}

const caster = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0];

if (!caster) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} Please SELECT exactly 1 token (the caster).`);

return;

}

const targets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

if (targets.length !== 1) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} Please TARGET exactly 1 token.`);

return;

}

const target = targets[0];

// --- X-only movement using DOCUMENT coords (top-left) ---

const original = { x: caster.document.x, y: caster.document.y };

const disp = caster.document.disposition;

const squares = 0.35; // tweak distance here

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

// Hostile (-1) => move RIGHT, else => move LEFT

const dx = (disp === -1) ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// IMPORTANT: Y stays EXACTLY original.y (no touching Y)

const destOut = { x: original.x + dx, y: original.y };

const destBack = { x: original.x, y: original.y };

// ✅ animation start hook

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { tag: "ClockworkBlades", tokenId: caster.id });

const seq = new Sequence()

// Movement sound

.sound()

.file(SFX_MOVE)

.volume(0.9)

// Move out (X-only destination)

.animation()

.on(caster)

.moveTowards(destOut)

.duration(350)

.waitUntilFinished()

// wait 0.5s

.wait(500)

// Target SFX + FX

.sound()

.file(SFX_TARGET)

.volume(0.9)

.effect()

.file(FX_TARGET)

.atLocation(target)

.scaleToObject(2.15)

.anchor({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 })

.opacity(1.0)

.belowTokens(false)

.waitUntilFinished()

// wait 0.5s

.wait(500)

// Move back (exact original)

.animation()

.on(caster)

.moveTowards(destBack)

.duration(350)

.waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

// Hard guarantee: snap back exactly (still does not change Y beyond original)

if (caster.document.x !== original.x || caster.document.y !== original.y) {

await caster.document.update({ x: original.x, y: original.y });

}

// ✅ animation end hook

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { tag: "ClockworkBlades", tokenId: caster.id });

})();

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// -----------------------------

// TUNING KNOBS

// -----------------------------

const MOVE_DURATION = 350; // ms (caster step forward/back)

const STEP_SQUARES = 0.35; // how far to step (in grid squares)

const POST_CAST_WAIT = 2000; // ms

const EST_CAST_VFX_MS = 900;

const EST_TARGET_VFX_MS = 1800;

const EXTRA_BUFFER_MS = 250;

const HOLD_FORWARD_MS =

EST_CAST_VFX_MS + POST_CAST_WAIT + EST_TARGET_VFX_MS + EXTRA_BUFFER_MS;

// Assets

const FX_CASTER =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastShapeSquare01_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const FX_TARGET =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Energy/IcosahedronRoll_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_POISON =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Condition_Poison.ogg";

// -----------------------------

// Payload resolve

// -----------------------------

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

for (const r of targetRefs) {

return;

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Stop: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ?? sourceToken?.document?.disposition ?? 0;

const casterMoveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

const offsetPx = (canvas.grid.size ?? 100) * STEP_SQUARES;

const dx = casterMoveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// -----------------------------

// Emit START

// -----------------------------

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "stop",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// -----------------------------

// PSEUDO availability

// -----------------------------

const hasPseudo = !!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play;

// Used to tighten animationEnd timing

const pseudoDoneKey = `oni.stop.pseudoDone.${Date.now()}.${foundry.utils.randomID()}`;

globalThis[pseudoDoneKey] = false;

// NEW: live position key for the pseudo clone center (canvas coords)

const pseudoPosKey = `oni.stop.pseudoPos.${Date.now()}.${foundry.utils.randomID()}`;

globalThis[pseudoPosKey] = null;

const waitForPseudoDone = async (timeoutMs = 12000) => {

const start = performance.now();

while (!globalThis[pseudoDoneKey]) {

if (performance.now() - start > timeoutMs) break;

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25));

}

};

// Helper to read the pseudo clone position (fallback to token center)

const getCasterVfxLocation = () => {

const p = globalThis[pseudoPosKey];

if (p && Number.isFinite(p.x) && Number.isFinite(p.y)) return { x: p.x, y: p.y };

return { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

};

// -----------------------------

// 1) Pseudo session: move out -> HOLD -> move back

// -----------------------------

if (hasPseudo) {

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("StopPseudo: casterToken missing");

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const dur = Number(params.dur ?? 300);

const hold = Number(params.hold ?? 0);

const doneKey = String(params.doneKey ?? "");

const posKey = String(params.posKey ?? "");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function writePos(obj) {

if (!posKey) return;

globalThis[posKey] = { x: obj.x, y: obj.y };

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const startTime = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - startTime) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

writePos(obj);

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

writePos(sprite); // initial position publish

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token visuals (local only) for the WHOLE session

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const startX = sprite.x;

const startY = sprite.y;

const outX = startX + dx;

const outY = startY;

// Move out

await animate(sprite, startX, startY, outX, outY, dur);

// Hold while Sequencer VFX/SFX plays

if (hold > 0) {

// keep publishing position during hold (in case other code reads it later)

writePos(sprite);

await wait(hold);

writePos(sprite);

}

// Move back

await animate(sprite, outX, outY, startX, startY, dur);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

writePos(sprite); // final publish

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy(); // IMPORTANT: no "true"

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

// Signal completion back to macro (local flag)

if (doneKey) globalThis[doneKey] = true;

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "stop.pseudoSession",

scriptSource: pseudoScriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

dx,

dur: MOVE_DURATION,

hold: HOLD_FORWARD_MS,

doneKey: pseudoDoneKey,

posKey: pseudoPosKey, // <-- NEW

},

meta: { source: "Stop" },

});

} else {

// Fallback: real token movement (only if pseudo missing)

const original = { x: sourceToken.document.x, y: sourceToken.document.y };

await sourceToken.document.update({ x: original.x + dx, y: original.y });

// approximate “pos” for caster VFX (token center)

globalThis[pseudoPosKey] = { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

globalThis[pseudoDoneKey] = true;

}

// -----------------------------

// 2) Sequencer timeline (VFX + SFX only)

// Start after the step-out finishes (+ tiny buffer)

// -----------------------------

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, MOVE_DURATION + 30));

// IMPORTANT: cast VFX centered on the pseudo clone position

const casterVfxLoc = getCasterVfxLocation();

const casterSeq = new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX_BEGIN)

.volume(0.9)

.effect()

.file(FX_CASTER)

.atLocation(casterVfxLoc) // <-- CHANGED: not sourceToken

.scaleToObject(1.5);

await casterSeq.play();

// Wait 2000ms (your requirement)

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, POST_CAST_WAIT));

// Target icosahedron + poison sound, then WAIT UNTIL FINISHED

const targetSeq = new Sequence();

targetSeq.sound().file(SFX_POISON).volume(0.9);

targetSeq

.effect()

.file(FX_TARGET)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scaleToObject(1.5)

.waitUntilFinished();

await targetSeq.play();

// -----------------------------

// Tighter animationEnd:

// wait for pseudo move-back to actually finish

// -----------------------------

if (hasPseudo) {

await waitForPseudoDone(12000);

} else {

// Fallback: return real token

const original = { x: sourceToken.document.x - dx, y: sourceToken.document.y };

await sourceToken.document.update({ x: original.x, y: original.y });

}

// Cleanup

try { delete globalThis[pseudoDoneKey]; } catch (_) {}

try { delete globalThis[pseudoPosKey]; } catch (_) {}

// -----------------------------

// Emit END (tight)

// -----------------------------

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "stop",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "stop", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();
